title: Is my still image video longer than the song?
fullTitle: FFmpeg -loop 1 -shortest: Picture Ends Early, 1 s of a 4.3 s Song

scenes.narration: You make a video from one still image and a song, with dash loop one and dash shortest. Is the video longer than the song? A four point three second song, measured frame by frame, on f f m peg six point one point one.
captions: A still image and a song, -loop 1 -shortest.
Is the video longer than the song?

scenes.narration: A picture and a song of four point three seconds. At one frame a second, the picture shows four frames and stops at four seconds. Copy the song instead of re-encoding it, and the picture stops at one second.
captions: 1 frame a second: 4 frames, the picture ends at 4.0 s.
Song copied: the picture ends at 1.0 s.

scenes.chapter: One picture, four songs, two readers
scenes.narration: The picture is a flat image. The songs are tones of four, four point three, four point three seven and four point nine nine seconds. Two readers: ffprobe packets, and decoded frames and samples. The control, a four second song, gives exactly one hundred frames, equal length.
captions: Control: 4.0 s gives 100 frames, equal length.

scenes.narration: With dash shortest and the song re-encoded, the picture is never longer. It stops after the floor of song length times frame rate: one hundred seven frames at twenty five, four at one. At one frame a second it ends up to a second early.
captions: Frames = floor(song length x frame rate).
At 1 fps the picture ends 0.30, 0.37, 0.99 s early.

scenes.narration: Copy the song with dash c colon a copy, and the picture ends earlier: one hundred five frames at twenty five. At one frame a second, one frame, one second of picture for a four point three second song. Frames waiting inside the encoder are dropped. Dash b f zero gives four frames, and so does ffv1.
captions: -c:a copy at 1 fps: 1 frame, 1.0 s of picture.

scenes.narration: So when is the video longer? With no stop option it runs to the limit: eight seconds. Dash f flags plus shortest does not stop at the song: ten seconds. And dash t, set to the song length, rounds: one hundred eight frames, point zero two seconds longer.

With dash shortest the picture is never longer, and with a copied song it can be much shorter: add dash b f zero. Not tested: other encoders, containers and songs, real images, players, and builds other than six point one point one.
captions: Not tested: other encoders, real images, players.
